components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt action with a hard tactile offset.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.16 0.025 255); border-radius: 4px; color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.52 0.16 247.4); font: 700 .74rem/1.2 'Fragment Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-3px,-3px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 oklch(0.16 0.025 255); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.64 0.18 247); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(1px,1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: White structural action that turns orange on intent.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.16 0.025 255); border-radius: 4px; color: oklch(0.16 0.025 255); background: oklch(1 0 0); font: 700 .74rem/1.2 'Fragment Mono', monospace; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.68 0.19 42); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.64 0.18 247); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Brief Input
components.description: Truth-first field with visible label and precise focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: oklch(0.16 0.025 255); font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: .68rem; } .ds-field input { padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.16 0.025 255); border-radius: 4px; color: oklch(0.16 0.025 255); background: oklch(1 0 0); font: 500 1rem/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.52 0.16 247.4); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.52 0.16 247.4) 26%, transparent); outline: none; }

components.name: Active Tab
components.description: A full-width cobalt state, never a floating pill.
components.css: .ds-tab-active { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.52 0.16 247.4); font: 700 .68rem/1.2 'Fragment Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-tab-active:hover { background: oklch(0.45 0.16 247.4); } .ds-tab-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.68 0.19 42); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.css: .ds-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; border: 2px solid oklch(0.16 0.025 255); color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.52 0.16 247.4); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-lane > span { padding: 18px 12px; border-right: 1px solid currentColor; font: 400 1.2rem/1 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; } .ds-lane > div { padding: 20px; } .ds-lane small { font: 700 .62rem/1.2 'Fragment Mono', monospace; } .ds-lane h3 { margin: 10px 0; font: 400 2rem/1 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-lane p { margin: 0; font: 500 .85rem/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-lane:hover { transform: translate(-4px,-4px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 oklch(0.16 0.025 255); }

narrative.overview: FIELD feels like a creative director's working surface placed inside a precise instrument panel. Its structure is exposed while softness comes from generous spacing, real photography and readable body type.
keyCharacteristics: Exposed structural seams and ruled ledgers.
One dominant visual decision per scene.
Cobalt for active state; orange for intervention.
Real images and artifacts instead of decorative blobs.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks something active, selected, or operational. It is never spread as atmospheric fog.

rules.name: The Orange Tape Rule
rules.body: Safety orange appears as a purposeful mark or state transition, not a universal accent.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Display type can be loud but never exceed three intentional lines on desktop or four on mobile.

rules.name: The Honest Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface moves because it is interactive or selected, never because every container needs decoration.

dos: Do expose assumptions, locks, provider, asset lineage, and rejection reasons.
Do use real photography, product references, prompt records, tables, diagrams, and process lines as visual proof.
Do design loading, validation, empty, success, copy, download, keyboard, and reduced-motion states.
donts: Don't resemble generic purple-blue AI SaaS or use cobalt as atmospheric fog.
Don't build soft glass dashboards or decorative glass cards.
Don't use equal-card landing pages or nested card grids.
Don't ship a prompt-box demo with no workflow.
Don't create chaotic neo-brutalist collage without a stable reading path.
